scope: The DevTools implementation was previously reviewed and archived. Review the production changes since the Flutter 3.0.5 release and this minor release preparation, not unrelated legacy KBD projections. Do not assume test success; publication is pending.
acceptance_criteria: npm 3.2.0 must include bounded metadata when a large mutation event exceeds eventBytesLimit.
Entity search must update promptly during continuous graph traffic without violating React hook rules.
Minor release versions: all 12 fixed npm packages and Chrome 3.2.0; Flutter and bundled companion 3.1.0.
No changed Flutter runtime source versus previously reviewed b1c18b4f; rebuild assets before publication.
Publish only after completed production path, assembled acceptance, clean committed package sources, independent review and dry-run.
No unrelated sovereign-sync work, no claims of human usability or physical-device certification.
